vi: Thiết kế Route 53 weighted ALIAS canary 80/20 split traffic DNS-level + health check fail-away: unhealthy canary self-remove khỏi response mà không downtime
Triển khai CloudFront distribution với cache behavior TTL, cache key policy (include/exclude query string/header/cookie), invalidation + origin failover
Bảo vệ S3 origin private bucket qua Origin Access Control (OAC) SigV4 signing, replace OAI legacy, bucket policy chỉ allow CloudFront principal
Chọn routing policy phù hợp: latency-based (region gần user), geolocation (compliance), failover (primary/secondary + health check), multivalue (health check + random)
Tối ưu edge cache global: WAF tại CloudFront edge, geo-restriction, viewer protocol policy HTTPS redirect, origin shield caching extra layer
en: Design Route 53 weighted ALIAS canary 80/20 DNS-level traffic split with health check fail-away: unhealthy canary self-removes from response without downtime
Deploy CloudFront distribution with cache behavior TTL, cache key policy (include/exclude query string/header/cookie), invalidation and origin failover
Secure S3 origin with private bucket via Origin Access Control (OAC) SigV4 signing, replace legacy OAI, bucket policy allows only CloudFront principal
Choose appropriate routing policy: latency-based (user nearest region), geolocation (compliance), failover (primary/secondary with health check), multivalue (health-checked random)
Optimize global edge cache: WAF at CloudFront edge, geo-restriction, viewer protocol policy HTTPS redirect, origin shield for extra caching layer
